event.felix_heart2.3.text: Now! Up, easy. ...A tuna. First try. Took me nine summers.
event.felix_heart2.3.why: eleven was also the heart 8 inches and Elara's sketch count

event.felix_heart5.0.text: Every fisher has a lucky charm. Mine's sat through forty years of dawns.
event.felix_heart5.0.why: five scenes opened on Mornin'; it was wallpaper, not a signature

event.past_the_point.0.text: There you both are. I promised you the boat. She's ready. The bailing tin is the elegant part.
event.past_the_point.0.why: calls back heart 5's promise; the narration now pays off 'leaks, politely' alone

event.past_the_point.5.text: Wear both, then. The knitted one can look brave. The real one can do the floating.
event.past_the_point.5.why: answers Elara wearing it over the real one; 'the tin' was ambiguous

event.past_the_point.4.text: Dawn's better with two. With three, it's an expedition. ...One place crossed off. I'll want a bigger boat for the rest.
event.past_the_point.4.why: drops the list count (41 or 42 by choice); thread is the rest of Elara's list

dlg.story.whistler.felix.0.text: I only whistle when I'm happy. Lately that's most evenings. Couldn't tell you why. ...Well. I could.
dlg.story.whistler.felix.0.why: intro already ends on the fish; subtext instead of a second fish joke

dlg.story.whistler.felix.r1.text: You got the wrong note exactly right. Nobody's ever whistled back. ...I've gone red. It's the sunset.
dlg.story.whistler.felix.r1.why: 'moved, mortified, mostly' copied heart 8's 'devastated, proud, mostly' shape

event.story_whistler_felix.after.text: Same hour tomorrow, same lane, same tune. You can pretend you were passing.
event.story_whistler_felix.after.why: evenings he is at the saloon, not the pond; keeps the promise where he actually is

dlg.story.pumpkin.felix.2.text: ...It might be. In my defense, I didn't eat it. I only admired it.
dlg.story.pumpkin.felix.2.why: the goats did not exist; now answers Tilda's vegetables jab

event.story_pumpkin_felix.after.text: Back it goes. Beside it, my biggest carp looked like bait. I'll not be telling that story.
event.story_pumpkin_felix.after.why: the photograph is not a thing in the game; a tall-teller refusing a story is the joke

event.felix_heart8.intro.text: The pond, and a line that's tugging. I've had a feeling all week. Hold the net. Don't breathe.
event.felix_heart8.intro.why: variety: Mornin' kept for heart 2 and partners only

dlg.felix.birthday.r0.text: Kind of you. I'll tell the fish. They won't care, but I'll feel taller.
dlg.felix.birthday.r0.why: avoids the overused 'Thank you' plus tail shape

event.felix_birthday.after.text: {if choice:bday.felix.wish}Two well-wishers before noon. Tilda, then you. Record year. I'll chalk it on her slate.{else}{if choice:bday.felix.story}The story's longer now. I added a hand. And you, at the end, holding the net.{else}Tomorrow, then, off the good rock. Best present I've had. Don't tell Tilda. She brought pie.{/if}{/if}
event.felix_birthday.after.why: wish branch repeated r0's fish; fish branch repeated the courtship's 'dawn, the pond, two lines'

dlg.felix.courtship.r0.text: Yes! Oh. Best catch of my life, and I wasn't even holding a rod.
dlg.felix.courtship.r0.why: the after line already sets the dawn date; no back-to-back 'Dawn'

event.felix_courtship.after.text: {if flag:choice.courtship.felix.yes}Tomorrow, then. The good rock, two lines. I'll bring the thermos. You bring yourself. That's plenty.{else}{if flag:choice.courtship.felix.friends}I'll still save you half the rock. That doesn't change. Rocks are loyal like that.{else}I'll ask again some dawn. You'll know it's coming. I'll go very quiet beforehand.{/if}{/if}
event.felix_courtship.after.why: friends and later branches echoed the shared r1/r2 words; later now points at courtship 2

event.felix_courtship2.intro.text: Second cast, then. You asked for time, and I gave it. Would you court me? Still slowly.

event.felix_courtship2.after.text: {if flag:choice.courtship.felix.yes}Worth the wait. Every tide of it. Tomorrow I bring the thermos and, for once, two cups.{else}{if flag:choice.courtship.felix.friends}The rock still has room for two. Rocks don't hold grudges. Neither do I.{else}More time, then. I've waited forty years for a partner. I can wait a season.{/if}{/if}
event.felix_courtship2.after.why: yes branch was a copy of courtship 1's; friends branch differs from courtship 1's now

dlg.felix.partners.r1.text: You take the rod. I'll take the thermos. Finest arrangement on the coast.
dlg.felix.partners.r1.why: 'two lines and the good rock' was the third use of that phrase

dlg.felix.partners.r2.text: The sun comes up. We don't say much. That's the whole plan.
dlg.felix.partners.r2.why: fewer talking-fish lines across the arc

event.felix_partners.after.text: {if choice:courtship.felix.shell}The shell sits on my shelf, by the best hook. It still says your name. Or 'hello'.{else}{if choice:courtship.felix.fish}One very small fish, all morning. We threw it back. I've already made it bigger.{else}The sunrise was quiet. So were we. Longest conversation I've ever had.{/if}{/if}
event.felix_partners.after.why: fish branch repeated 'two lines' and 'best catch'; now ends on the tall-tale tic

event.overheard_tilda_felix_3.l3.text: I chalked it life-size. Then I added a hand. Don't tell the pond.
event.overheard_tilda_felix_3.l3.why: 'this big' was in six scenes; still sets up Tilda's 'The pond always knows'

event.overheard_felix_elara_2.l1.text: Three feet, nose to tail. Last spring it was two. It grows in the telling.
event.overheard_felix_elara_2.l1.why: specific number instead of another 'this big'; Elara's 'that big' still lands

threads.story_pumpkin_felix: The one fish story Felix refuses to tell.
threads.felix_heart8: The fish's next telling, or next year's dawn.
threads.felix_birthday: Tomorrow's dawn off the good rock, or Tilda's slate.
threads.felix_courtship: When will the quiet dawn come that means he asks again?

notes: past_the_point narration 'The boat leaks, politely' now pays off heart 5 alone; my .0 no longer repeats it.
Elara's past_point list has no count now; my .4 dropped 'Forty-one to go' to match (41 or 42 by her heart 8 choice).
Variety: Mornin' now opens only felix_heart2 and felix_partners; 'this big' kept in festival lanterns, heart 8 and birthday r1 only.
story_whistler_felix plays 18-21 in the Village while Felix's schedule has him at the saloon from two; the scene is fine, but I no longer promise the pond in the evening.
